[P2] Recheck relationships against retained boundary observations

This accessor reads only frozen events. For lifecycle 3, a frozen controlled-task exit at 35 followed by a retirement snapshot reporting exit at 38 and fault release at 36 still passes the release check: it compares 36 against 35. The final retirement audit also uses the frozen exit, allowing fault release to supply the cleanup being asserted. Compare every retained relevant boundary in the fault-release, disposal, and late-activity checks, filtering task exits by controlled-task identity, and add boundary-only correction regressions.
